# Crennect

> Crennect is a brand and creative agency helping new-age, high-aspiration brands become the obvious choice in their category. We combine brand strategy, design, content, and AI capabilities into one integrated growth engine.

## About

Crennect LLP is a Mumbai-based creative agency working with founders, CMOs, and enterprise leaders to build category-leading brands. We are registered under the MSME Act, 2006.

- Website: https://www.crennect.com
- Email: reach@crennect.com
- Phone: +91 79774 93025
- Location: 13, Embassy 247 Park, Tower B, Lal Bahadur Shastri Marg, Vikhroli West, Mumbai 400083, India

## What we do

We work across six service lines:

1. Brand Strategy and Positioning — defining who a brand is, who it serves, and why it wins
2. Creative and Campaigns — campaigns, content, and digital experiences designed to break into markets
3. Content, Video and Storytelling — film, video, photography, and brand storytelling
4. Social and Digital Presence — social media management and digital marketing
5. Product and Experience — product design and experience design
6. AI and Tech Capabilities — generative AI-led storytelling, automation, 3D and immersive ad campaigns
